_comment: Frozen inputs of tools/generate_new_faction_kingdoms.py that no longer exist in characters/lords.xml.
#648 folded the vanilla-id lords' characters/lords.xml rows into their lords.xslt templates, so these
rows and the Gondor faces are gone from the file the generator reads. Copied from characters/lords.xml
at origin/bannerlord-1.5.x bea989108 (text with LF line ends, as read_doc returns it). The
generated blocks stay byte-identical only while these strings do: edit them only to change the generated
lords on purpose, and never point the generator at another shipped lord instead. One such edit: the
skin field (KeyPart1 bits 48 to 53) of 15 keys, lowered to 4 to 7 by #1190 so Arthedain's lords match the
fair Gondor lords; lord_1_57_1's row carries the same change.
lords: template rows by id (lord_1_57_1, Arthedain's lady; lord_4_16_1, South Rhovanion's lady).
face_pools: per faces_from culture, the ordered male and female faces the shipped realm was generated
from (the old face_pool: one face per distinct key of each Culture.<culture> Lord row, in file order).
